rationale: From brief 2026-10-10-nursery-crib-mattress-checklist.md. Decision line: "Build a narrow safety checklist rather than another general nursery guide". Scored against the PLAYBOOK rubric by kg:score (see scores.assumptions).

scores.assumptions: utility: priority P2 from the brief (researcher judgement, not measured demand) | evidence: no supported claim with current evidence on overlapping or implementing pages | gap: closest page page:en/nursery/how-long-does-a-crib-last at 0.137 | differentiation: formats: checklist, planner or worksheet, measurement guide | links: 6 en page(s) in hub nursery; 3 published overlapping page(s) | fit: tool/checklist/buying-guide format (+1) | penalty: YMYL review burden +1; no named reviewer lined up +1

blocking: evidence: no source evidence linked to the opportunity (gates.evidence is false)
ymyl: no named human reviewer lined up (gates.reviewer); approval is a human transition

hypothesis.label: hypothesis only: CALIBRATION_HYPOTHESIS weights over known components; not used for ranking

scores.method: playbook-v1 (derived from graph and brief signals)
